title: Generalized Dual Decomposition
summary: We study two-stage stochastic optimization models with mixed-integer decision variables appearing in both stages. For these models, dual decomposition enables parallel computing implementation and can quickly provide a lower bound for the optimal value. However, the lower bound thus obtained is not exact in general due to the lack of strong duality. In this paper, we propose a generalized dual decomposition (GDD) that extends the linear regularizer used in dual decomposition to a general nonlinear one, which still admits parallelization while exhibiting strong duality.
